expected_level_description: You can: - manage a portfolio of contracts, including clinical and technology contracts - use contract remedies, such as service credits, when performance falls short - manage changes, disputes, and renewals within the procurement rules - plan exit early and test exit plans before contracts end

You can: - segment suppliers by risk and value and plan how to manage each group - run strategic reviews with key suppliers, including roadmap and improvement plans - manage supplier risks, such as financial failure, cyber incidents, and supply chain issues
You can: - keep exit plans and asset and data registers up to date - track notice periods and exit milestones

You can: - buy standard software, hardware, and licences through frameworks - track licence numbers, renewals, and true-up dates - include standard security and data protection requirements in documents
You can: - apply the procurement rules that fit a straightforward purchase - publish notices and keep records that meet transparency rules - spot when a request risks breaking the rules and raise it
You can: - negotiate prices and terms for low-value or routine purchases - prepare data and options for a negotiation led by others

You can: - act as the point of contact for contracted suppliers - understand appropriate internal contacts and processes within a government department - understand how and when third parties should be brought into digital, data and technology projects

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - record and update risks for your area - suggest controls and track actions
